title: Analysis Set
description: A file set for analyses. Analysis sets represent the results of a computational analysis of raw genomic data or other analyses.

file_set_type.comment: Principal analysis and resource analysis sets require input_file_sets.

input_file_sets.description: The file set(s) required for this analysis.

file_set_type.description: The level of this analysis set. An intermediate analysis cannot be interpreted on its own and is part of a principal analysis. A principal analysis is the core analysis for an experimental design, the results of which can be interpretable on their own. A resource analysis is a resource used to perform a principal analysis such as a donor x gene count matrix.
file_set_type.comment: File set type describes the content of the analysis set. Intermediate analyses are processed data which are not the final results of an experiment. Principal analyses are processed data which are the final results of an experiment.A resource analysis is a resource used to perform a principal analysis such as a donor x gene count matrix.

total_islet_cell_volume.title: Total Islet Cell Volume (IEQ)
total_islet_cell_volume.description: Total islet equivalents (IEQ) used for data normalization, if available. 1 IEQ = 1 islet with a diameter of 150 μm.

total_insulin_content.title: Total Islet Insulin Content
total_insulin_content.description: Total islet insulin content with unit, used for data normalization (e.g., ng, ng/ml)
total_insulin_content.comment: Example value from perifusion metadata: 21527 ng/ml

total_glucagon_content.title: Total Islet Glucagon Content
total_glucagon_content.description: Total islet glucagon content with unit, used for data normalization (e.g., pg, pg/ml)
total_glucagon_content.comment: Example value from perifusion metadata: 375350 ng/ml (HPAP), 1267659 pg/ml (IIDP)

total_dna_content.title: Total Islet DNA Content
total_dna_content.description: Total islet DNA content with unit, used for data normalization (e.g., μg)

normalized_insulin_secretion_units.title: Normalized Islet Insulin Secretion Units
normalized_insulin_secretion_units.description: Units used to report dynamic or static insulin secretion (e.g., ng/100 IEQs/min; % insulin content/min; ng/DNA/min)
normalized_insulin_secretion_units.comment: Example value from perifusion metadata: ng/100 IEQs/min; %content/min

normalized_glucagon_secretion_units.title: Normalized Islet Glucagon Secretion Units
normalized_glucagon_secretion_units.description: Units used to report dynamic or static glucagon secretion (e.g., pg/100 IEQs/min; % glucagon content/min; pg/DNA/min)
normalized_glucagon_secretion_units.comment: Example value from perifusion metadata: pg/100 IEQs/min; %content/min

normalized_insulin_content.title: Normalized Islet Insulin Content
normalized_insulin_content.description: Islet insulin content expressed per cell volume or DNA content (e.g., ng/100 IEQ; pg/IEQ; ng/DNA)
normalized_insulin_content.comment: Example value from perifusion metadata: 17.52 ng/IEQ

normalized_glucagon_content.title: Normalized Islet Glucagon Content
normalized_glucagon_content.description: Islet glucagon content expressed per cell volume or DNA content (e.g., ng/100 IEQ; pg/IEQ; ng/DNA)
normalized_glucagon_content.comment: Example value from perifusion metadata: 305 pg/IEQ
